mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_userchat ( cno, r_title, r_tag, leader, r_regdate, sch_date, enabled ) VALUES ( seq_cno.nextval, #{r_title}, #{r_tag}, #{leader}, SYSDATE, TO_DATE(#{sch_date}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), 1 )
mapper.select: SELECT uc.*, u1.name AS leader_name, u2.name AS member_name FROM tbl_userchat uc LEFT JOIN tbl_user u1 ON uc.leader = u1.uno LEFT JOIN tbl_user u2 ON uc.member = u2.uno ORDER BY uc.cno DESC

SELECT uc.*, u1.name AS leader_name, u2.name AS member_name FROM tbl_userchat uc LEFT JOIN tbl_user u1 ON uc.leader = u1.uno LEFT JOIN tbl_user u2 ON uc.member = u2.uno WHERE uc.r_tag = #{r_tag} ORDER BY uc.cno DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_userchat SET leader = member, member = null WHERE cno = #{cno}
mapper.select: SELECT o.ono AS ono, c.corpnm AS corpName, u.profileimage AS profileImage, o.o_tag AS category, o.o_title AS title FROM tbl_offers o JOIN tbl_cinfo c ON o.uno = c.uno LEFT JOIN tbl_uprofile u ON o.uno = u.uno ORDER BY o.ono DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_submissions ( uno, ono, o_title, o_tag, o_content, o_regdate ) VALUES ( #{uno}, #{ono}, #{o_title}, #{o_tag}, #{o_content}, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT o.ono, c.corpnm AS corpName, u.profileimage AS profileImage, o.o_tag AS category, o.o_title AS title FROM tbl_fav f JOIN tbl_offers o ON f.ono = o.ono JOIN tbl_cinfo c ON o.uno = c.uno LEFT JOIN tbl_uprofile u ON o.uno = u.uno WHERE f.uno = #{uno}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tbl_fav WHERE uno=#{uno} and ono=#{ono}
mapper.select: SELECT s.uno, s.ono, o.o_title AS o_title, o.o_tag AS o_tag, s.o_content AS o_content FROM tbl_submissions s JOIN tbl_offers o ON s.ono = o.ono WHERE s.uno = #{uno}
